test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The ratio of copper and zinc in the brass is 13 : 7. How much zinc will there be in 100 kg of brass?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total ratio parts = 13 (**Copper**) + 7 (**Zinc**) = 20 units.

20 units corresponds to the total weight of **Brass** = 100 kg.

1 unit = 100 ÷ 20 = 5 kg.

Weight of **Zinc** = 7 units × 5 kg = 35 kg.

**∴ The correct answer is 35 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of **Copper** to **Zinc** = 13 : 7

Total weight of **Brass** = 100 kg

**Formula Used:**

Quantity of a component = (Ratio of component ÷ Sum of ratios) × Total quantity

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7dc4380afe1d82214817ee2ea2d725ba82325bb59888373a92bc60c2730963c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of ratio parts = 13 + 7 = 20

⇒ Quantity of **Zinc** = (7 ÷ 20) × 100

⇒ Quantity of **Zinc** = 7 × 5

⇒ Quantity of **Zinc** = 35 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 35 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio and Proportion

If a total quantity Q is divided in ratio a:b, the parts are [a/(a+b)] × Q and [b/(a+b)] × Q.

Alloys

**Brass** is an alloy primarily consisting of **Copper** and **Zinc**. The sum of the individual weights of the metals equals the total weight of the alloy.

Percentage Composition

To find the percentage of **Zinc**: (7 / 20) × 100 = 35%.</p
